{
  "description": "Agent capability demonstration scenarios — shows agent types across 9 categories with graph-based analysis. Uses Meridian Financial Services (MFS) demo data.",
  "version": "2.0.0",
  "organization": "Meridian Financial Services",
  "scenarios": [
    {
      "id": "agent-trace-impact",
      "agent_type": "retrieval",
      "category": "tool_using",
      "title": "Trace and Impact Analysis",
      "question": "Trace PAY-101 to its implementation and assess the blast radius of changing TokenizationService.tokenize_card()",
      "expected_tools": [
        "search_entity",
        "find_path",
        "impact_analysis"
      ],
      "expected_output": "Path from WorkItem PAY-101 through MR !301 → Commit → File → CodeSymbol, plus dependent entities across payment gateway"
    },
    {
      "id": "agent-incident-root-cause",
      "agent_type": "goal_based",
      "category": "deliberative",
      "title": "Incident Root Cause Analysis",
      "question": "What caused INC0080101 (payment timeout spike) and which deployment introduced the regression?",
      "expected_tools": [
        "search_entity",
        "neighbors",
        "find_path"
      ],
      "expected_output": "Incident → affected CI mfs-payment-gateway → recent CHG0090101 → Pipeline 9001 → MR !301 → PAY-101 tokenization change chain"
    },
    {
      "id": "agent-compliance-check",
      "agent_type": "compliance",
      "category": "enterprise",
      "title": "PCI DSS Compliance Verification",
      "question": "Verify that all cardholder data handling meets PCI DSS encryption and key management requirements",
      "expected_tools": [
        "search_entity",
        "neighbors",
        "get_entity"
      ],
      "expected_output": "Compliance check against PAY-201 encryption at rest, PAY-202 HSM key rotation, token vault architecture, audit trail in mfs_audit_db"
    },
    {
      "id": "agent-release-governance",
      "agent_type": "workflow",
      "category": "orchestration",
      "title": "Release Governance Check",
      "question": "Is the Payment Gateway v2 release ready? Check all test suites, pipeline status, monitoring, and documentation completeness",
      "expected_tools": [
        "search_entity",
        "find_path",
        "neighbors"
      ],
      "expected_output": "Multi-step workflow: TC-PAY-007 IN_PROGRESS and TC-PAY-008 NOT_RUN are blockers; Grafana dashboards configured; Confluence docs present but runbook needs update"
    },
    {
      "id": "agent-anomaly-detection",
      "agent_type": "monitor",
      "category": "autonomous",
      "title": "Graph Anomaly Detection",
      "question": "Find orphan vertices, disconnected components, and suspicious patterns in the MFS enterprise graph",
      "expected_tools": [
        "search_entity",
        "neighbors",
        "graph_analytics"
      ],
      "expected_output": "Anomalies: mfs-customer-portal code entities not linked to any Jira story; settlement engine has no Kibana dashboard; some Figma components not linked to code"
    },
    {
      "id": "agent-design-trace",
      "agent_type": "design_trace",
      "category": "reactive",
      "title": "Design-to-Implementation Traceability",
      "question": "Which Figma designs have been implemented and which are pending for the payment portal?",
      "expected_tools": [
        "search_entity",
        "neighbors",
        "find_path"
      ],
      "expected_output": "PaymentCard → PaymentForm.tsx (implemented), CurrencySelector → (no code link yet), SettlementTable → (partially implemented)"
    },
    {
      "id": "agent-knowledge-provenance",
      "agent_type": "provenance",
      "category": "meta_cognitive",
      "title": "Knowledge Provenance Audit",
      "question": "How was the payment gateway architecture documentation created and when was it last verified?",
      "expected_tools": [
        "search_entity",
        "get_entity",
        "lineage_trace"
      ],
      "expected_output": "Confluence page created by Sarah Chen on 2026-08-15, last edited 2026-09-28, linked to 3 code repos, 2 API specs, not verified since PAY-103 multicurrency addition"
    },
    {
      "id": "agent-blast-radius",
      "agent_type": "blast_radius",
      "category": "collaboration",
      "title": "Change Blast Radius Assessment",
      "question": "What is the blast radius of upgrading sqlalchemy in mfs-common-libs?",
      "expected_tools": [
        "search_entity",
        "impact_analysis",
        "neighbors"
      ],
      "expected_output": "Affects mfs-payment-gateway (DBClient), mfs-fraud-engine (model storage), mfs-settlement-engine; 4 pipelines, 2 ServiceNow changes needed, 12 test cases to re-run"
    },
    {
      "id": "agent-peer-review",
      "agent_type": "peer_review",
      "category": "collaboration",
      "title": "Cross-Domain Peer Review",
      "question": "Review the fraud engine's interaction with the payment gateway — are there circular dependencies or missing error handlers?",
      "expected_tools": [
        "search_entity",
        "find_path",
        "neighbors"
      ],
      "expected_output": "FraudAPI calls PaymentAPI for transaction data; no circular dependency found; missing error handler in FraudScorer when payment service is unavailable"
    },
    {
      "id": "agent-test-coverage",
      "agent_type": "test_coverage",
      "category": "tool_using",
      "title": "Test Coverage Gap Analysis",
      "question": "Analyze test coverage gaps for the webhook notification system across unit, integration, and E2E tests",
      "expected_tools": [
        "graph_query",
        "test_mapping",
        "coverage_analysis"
      ],
      "expected_output": "Coverage percentages per test tier (unit, integration, E2E), untested code paths in webhook handlers, recommendations for priority test additions"
    },
    {
      "id": "agent-incident-correlation",
      "agent_type": "incident_correlation",
      "category": "deliberative",
      "title": "Incident-Deployment Correlation",
      "question": "Correlate incident INC0080103 with recent deployments and changes to identify contributing factors",
      "expected_tools": [
        "incident_timeline",
        "change_correlation",
        "deployment_history"
      ],
      "expected_output": "Timeline of INC0080103 mapped to recent CHG records and pipeline deployments, contributing factor ranking with confidence scores"
    },
    {
      "id": "agent-security-scan",
      "agent_type": "security_scan",
      "category": "enterprise",
      "title": "Service Account Permission Scan",
      "question": "Scan service account permissions across all pods and identify any over-privileged access patterns",
      "expected_tools": [
        "service_account_audit",
        "permission_analysis",
        "compliance_check"
      ],
      "expected_output": "List of service accounts with their permission scopes, flagged over-privileged accounts, least-privilege violation details, remediation recommendations"
    },
    {
      "id": "agent-deployment-readiness",
      "agent_type": "deployment_readiness",
      "category": "orchestration",
      "title": "Production Deployment Readiness Assessment",
      "question": "Assess production readiness for the webhook notification system deployment (CHG0090401)",
      "expected_tools": [
        "test_results",
        "dependency_check",
        "rollback_plan",
        "approval_status"
      ],
      "expected_output": "Readiness checklist with pass/fail status for each gate: test results, dependency compatibility, rollback plan existence, CAB approval status"
    },
    {
      "id": "agent-knowledge-debt",
      "agent_type": "knowledge_debt",
      "category": "meta_cognitive",
      "title": "Knowledge Debt Identification",
      "question": "Identify knowledge debt in the payment gateway codebase - undocumented services, stale wiki pages, missing architecture decisions",
      "expected_tools": [
        "documentation_audit",
        "staleness_check",
        "coverage_gap"
      ],
      "expected_output": "Knowledge debt inventory: undocumented services count, stale Confluence pages with last-updated dates, missing ADRs, documentation coverage percentage"
    },
    {
      "id": "agent-service-dependency",
      "agent_type": "service_dependency",
      "category": "reactive",
      "title": "Service Dependency Mapping",
      "question": "Map all service dependencies for mfs-payment-gateway including database connections, Kafka topics, and external services",
      "expected_tools": [
        "dependency_graph",
        "infrastructure_map",
        "connection_audit"
      ],
      "expected_output": "Complete dependency map: database connections (pghost-prod-01, mfs_payments_db), Kafka topics (payment.events, fraud.scores), external service integrations, health check endpoints"
    },
    {
      "id": "agent-timeline-reconstruction",
      "agent_type": "timeline_reconstruction",
      "category": "deliberative",
      "title": "Incident Timeline Reconstruction",
      "question": "Reconstruct the complete timeline of events leading to the connection pool leak (PAY-901) from first detection to resolution",
      "expected_tools": [
        "event_timeline",
        "log_correlation",
        "change_history"
      ],
      "expected_output": "Chronological event timeline: first alert timestamp, escalation events, diagnostic steps, root cause identification, fix deployment, verification — with evidence links"
    },
    {
      "id": "agent-compliance-audit",
      "agent_type": "compliance_audit",
      "category": "enterprise",
      "title": "PCI DSS Payment Path Compliance Audit",
      "question": "Audit PCI DSS compliance for the payment processing path from API ingress to database storage",
      "expected_tools": [
        "encryption_audit",
        "access_control_check",
        "logging_verification",
        "network_segmentation"
      ],
      "expected_output": "PCI DSS compliance report: encryption at rest and in transit status, access control findings, audit logging completeness, network segmentation verification, overall compliance score"
    }
  ]
}
